fields.description: Sets one item's status to "archived" by id and refreshes its updatedAt, returning the updated item under `data`. Unknown id returns 404 with code "not_found". Touches exactly one record; there is no unarchive tool in this API to undo it.
fields.title: Archive an item

fields.description: Returns every item in the demo store, unfiltered and unpaginated, as `data`: id, name, status (active|archived), amount in cents, updatedAt ISO 8601. Takes no arguments and changes nothing.
fields.title: List demo items
